Title: Mr. Peabody & Sherman
Writer: Jay Ward, Craig Wright, Robert Ben Garant
Actors: Ty Burrell, Max Charles, Stephen Colbert
Plot: Sherman, a young boy, misuses a time machine made by his scientist father Mr. Peabody and causes the world history to go haywire. It is now up to Mr. Peabody to rescue his son and the world.
Awards: Nominated for 1 BAFTA Award2 wins & 16 nominations total
